info.title: MR International LLC Ecommerce API
info.description:
Express 5 + Prisma 6 (MongoDB) backend.

## Conventions
- Base path: `/api/v1`
- Success response: `{ success, message, data, meta? }`
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`
- Roles: `supper_admin`, `admin`, `retail`, `wholesale`
- Upload routes accept multipart form fields + files

## Module coverage
- **Auth**
- **OTP**
- **Users**
- **Categories**
- **Brands**
- **Products**
- **Cart**
- **Wishlist**
- **Orders**
- **Payments**
- **Stripe**
- **Deals**
- **Banners**
- **Promo Codes**
- **Prep Services**
- **Reviews**
- **Contents**
- **FAQ**
- **Notifications**
- **Dashboard**
- **Contact**
- **Address**

Total documented operations: **102**

post.summary: Refresh access token from cookie/body refresh token

post.description: Requires header `token` = OTP session JWT from register/resend (`data.otpToken.token`). Body only needs `otp` (6 digits). Do not send email in this body. Token expires in 3 minutes.

parameters.description: OTP session JWT from register/resend response (data.otpToken.token). Not Authorization Bearer.

post.description:
Creates an order from the authenticated user cart. When `promoCode` is provided it is validated and applied; the resulting discount is stored on the order and a redemption is recorded. Manual `discount` is only used when no promo code is sent.

Roles: retail, wholesale

discount.description: Manual discount fallback when promoCode is omitted

promoCode.description: Optional promo code applied at checkout

Validate a promo code against a cart subtotal
post.description: Checks active window, usage limits, customer type, and min order amount. Pass Bearer token when available so per-user limits are enforced. Returns computed discount for the given subtotal.

subtotal.description: Cart subtotal used to compute discount

Codes are stored uppercase. Percentage discountValue must be 1–100. Soft-deleted codes with the same code can be reactivated by creating again.
